pages.text: $(danger)Icarus detonates instantly$() if the shield reaches 0, or if any part is broken while the core holds antimatter. There is no countdown.

pages.title: The Blast
pages.text: The radius grows with the core charge: about 125 blocks for 2 capsules, 400 for a full 64.$(br2)Everything inside dies. Outside, damage and knockback fade with distance.

pages.title: Aftermath
pages.text: A deep crater with no drops. The floor burns for minutes and stays radioactive for days, and a soot pall darkens the sky over the region.$(br2)Servers can turn terrain destruction off.

pages.title: Staying Alive
pages.text: Keep the shield above the drain, watch the predictions, and use CLIP the moment the core runs away.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA would like you to do better than they did.$()
